title: Pronouns
description: Practice personal, possessive, and indefinite pronouns through picture-supported matching, sentence completion, and writing activities.
learningFocus: Use personal, possessive, and indefinite pronouns (L.1.1(d)).
adultGuidance: Pronouns take the place of a name. Help your child say the name first, then the short word that takes its place. Point to the picture and ask who it shows. For mine, yours, his, hers, ours, and theirs, ask whose thing it is. Then let your child use a pronoun in a sentence of their own.
